agent.instructions: File restores: if the person has not said which machine to restore to, as VBR names it, and which folder, ask them. Steps: find the restore point, start a file restore, browse to confirm the path, restore the items, and always unmount the file system afterwards. A file restore cannot be downloaded to the person's own computer.
